events.title: NEUROBROOD — Kickstarter Pre-Launch Page Is Live!
events.summary: The NEUROBROOD Kickstarter pre-launch page is now live!You can follow the project and get notified when the campaign launches.Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/enreistudios/neurobroodThank you for your support!

events.title: NEUROBROOD Demo Now Available in 7 Languages!
events.summary: The NEUROBROOD demo now supports four additional languages!New languages:FrenchSpanishBrazilian PortugueseSimplified ChineseAlong with Russian, English, and German, the demo is now available in 7 languages!Thank you for your support! We hope even more players can now experience the world of NEUROBROOD.

events.title: NEUROBROOD Joins Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: NEUROBROOD is taking part in Steam Next Fest, October 19–26!Step into a dark cyberpunk world where artificial dreams turn into nightmares.The free demo is available now, featuring cinematic 2D artwork, an unsettling atmosphere, and choices that shape the story.Give it a try, and if you enjoy the experience, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!Thank you for your support!

events.title: Major Demo Update!
events.summary: The NEUROBROOD demo has received a major update!Here's what's changed:Improved artwork — Visuals throughout the demo have been significantly enhanced.Expanded story — Additional scenes and dialogue.Player choices — Choices have been introduced, allowing your decisions to influence how events unfold.Updated audio — Improved music and sound effects.New teaser — A fresh look at the game.If you've already played the demo, now is a great time to revisit it!Thank you for your support!
